summary: First full test run of Pinball Forge. Backend: 13/14 pytest passed (generate w/ Claude, CRUD, sanitize, saved filter, score, assets upload/soft-delete, file serving, 404/422/400 handling). ONLY failure: art generation - model 'gpt-image-1' is rejected by the Emergent proxy (400 'The model gpt-image-1 does not exist'); reproduced twice. A probe with model='gpt-image-1.5' via the same OpenAIImageGeneration class SUCCEEDED (1.47MB PNG). Frontend: Home (presets, switches, brand picker), brand-enabled generation via UI (table generated in ~30s, brand caps on bumpers, apron logos, backglass-brand-logo visible), Play (Space start+launch, arrow-key flippers move canvas, score increments to 25k, ball save, touch buttons), Editor (canvas click opens inspector, label/points edit, add bumper, gravity slider, comboMax, mission title/event select, backglass title -> Save -> reload persisted & shown on Play), Library (save from play, card shows, delete confirm removes, GET 404), Brand Kit (5 seeded, upload, delete) all work. Main frontend bug: mobile (390px) horizontal overflow on Play page.

critical.issue: Image generation always fails: litellm 400 "The model 'gpt-image-1' does not exist" from Emergent proxy. art_status becomes 'error: ...'. Probe with model='gpt-image-1.5' (same emergentintegrations OpenAIImageGeneration) works. Note: library only adds 'quality' param for dall-e-3/gpt-image-1, so with 1.5 quality is ignored (fine).

minor.issue: emergentintegrations OpenAIImageGeneration.generate_images calls litellm.image_generation synchronously inside an async fn -> blocks the FastAPI event loop for the whole image generation (30-60s x 3 kinds when generate_art=true). Wrap call in asyncio.to_thread(lambda: asyncio.run(...)) or run in a thread/executor.
asyncio.create_task results not referenced -> tasks may be garbage-collected; keep refs in a set.
Art files/db.files records of deleted tables are left orphaned (no cleanup).

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow: documentElement.scrollWidth=450 vs 390. Single-column grid track grows to min-content of DMD text (dmd-main-text 'PRESS LAUNCH TO START') so backglass, controls, playfield, missions all cut off on right. Fix: add grid-cols-1/[minmax(0,1fr)] for base breakpoint or min-w-0 on sections; make DMD text truncate.
First Space/launch press only starts the game ('PRESS LAUNCH TO START' -> 0); a second hold&release is needed to actually shoot the ball. Slightly confusing UX.
Brand bumper caps / apron logos load from 300-570KB PNGs via backend proxy and pop in after a few seconds; until then plain bumpers + text are drawn. Consider caching/thumbnails.

integration_issues.issue: Fails due to backend gpt-image-1 model error; Art tab correctly shows art-error-backglass.

issues: Seed asset 'URLinc Pill Badge' renders as a thin sliver (image mostly transparent/cropped); 'Round Badge' bottom cropped
Brand name input not cleared after successful upload
Backglass subtitle (e.g. 'NEON RACING LEAGUE') very low contrast against gradient
DMD main text truncated with ellipsis ('PRESS LAUNC…') on desktop
Bumper/saucer labels truncated at 14 chars ('URLinc Pit Lan')
Ball counter shows 'BALL -/3' before game start
Palette uses native <input type=color> browser picker (inconsistent with shadcn styling)

action_items: Switch image model from 'gpt-image-1' to 'gpt-image-1.5' in server.py run_art (verified working via probe), then retest art flow
Run image generation off the event loop (asyncio.to_thread) so the API is not blocked during art generation
Fix mobile horizontal overflow on Play page (grid min-width / DMD text truncation)
Optional: single launch press should start game AND shoot; fix Pill Badge seed asset; improve backglass subtitle contrast
